overview: Living-species clocks, fossil-integrated total-evidence dating and historical-biogeography models provide different views of cycad timing and range contraction.

ecology.habitat: Terrestrial tropical to subtropical habitats in living species

traits: Fossil leaf sampling used in total-evidence models
evidenceSummary: Models disagree with a simple synchronous recent radiation; fossil integration supports older regional histories but does not turn model nodes into direct fossil occurrences.

overview: Ginkgoxylon liaoningense PB22285 provides a well-bounded Jurassic wood-anatomy exemplar without being treated as the first ginkgophyte or an associated leaf species.

ecology.habitat: Terrestrial forest or woodland inferred for the wood producer
ecology.bodySize: Tree-sized producer inferred from secondary wood

evidenceSummary: The Tiaojishan specimen directly supports wood characters and locality; its affinity and evolutionary position do not establish a complete phylum range or ancestor sequence.
